resources.string: "Saved gateway data could not be unlocked. It has been preserved."
"Demo data — add your own gateway to perform this action."
"Phone polling ended. Detached VPS jobs may continue; check the recorded installation."
"Reboot requested. Wait for SSH, then resume the pair."
"Browse the guide or stories while setup runs. Return here using the progress shortcut."
"A planning range, not a countdown. Package downloads, network waits and a required reboot can take longer. The bar counts finished checkpoints."
"A stopped phone coordinator does not cancel detached VPS jobs. Resume uses the recorded owner and stages. Do not reset a running job."
"Open the saved gateway and inspect its job first."
"Your gateways. Your access. One place to steer."
"Bring a fresh VPS. Rook will take care of the setup, then help you share and manage access."
"Check the server to get its current status."
"Connected clients lose Internet access. SSH management stays available. Use Resume pair to verify and activate again."
"Reset both VPN nodes before swapping their roles."
"Roles swapped. Install the fresh pair; custom VPN addresses now default to the new nodes."
"Group people, label device logins, and share profiles."
"No users loaded. Refresh a managed gateway to see access."
"Monthly history is disabled. Live session counters remain available."
"Connection monitoring is unavailable. Refresh to try again."
"No active connections in the latest server snapshot."
"The user can reconnect while their login remains enabled."
"History is stored on the VPS. Enabling starts collection; disabling keeps saved totals but stops new collection."
"Accounting has recorded a monitoring gap or counter reset. Totals are estimates."
"Endpoints can change between mobile data and Wi-Fi. They do not identify physical devices. Refresh shows the server\'s current observation."
"Installation found on the VPS; reconnecting to its status."
"Rookstride stopped before sending credentials. Verify a VPS replacement or key change with your provider.\n\nSaved: "
"\n\nCompare this SSH fingerprint with your provider\'s console if available. Trust it only when it belongs to your server."
"Saved data is locked; preserve it before clearing app storage."
"Do this after verifying the server was replaced or its SSH keys intentionally changed. The next connection will ask you to verify the new fingerprint."
"This removes saved access from this app. The VPS and its users continue running."
"Check the name, address, port and administrator login."
"Adds the management helper to a supported existing gateway. Enabling the monitoring interface may briefly restart the VPN; clients can reconnect."
"Installs StrongSwan, AdGuard Home, DNS and firewall settings on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VPS. Existing VPN configurations are refused."
"Use a valid login and a password of at least 16 characters."

"Use two distinct fresh Ubuntu 24.04 nodes. Rookstride installs the exit first, keeps the entry blocked, then checks the second hop before activation. A matching kernel may require a reboot. This is an experimental installation mode."
"Optional when your phone cannot reach one SSH endpoint. Both SSH identities stay pinned. This changes administration only; the VPN route stays the same."
"Remember passwords and keys securely on this phone"
"Check both addresses, ports, logins and the VPN password."
"Entry and exit must be different nodes."

"This removes VPN accounts, certificates, tunnel keys, DNS data and usage history from both nodes. Connected clients lose access. Ubuntu, SSH and unrelated files stay installed. You can then install either role on either node."
"Both nodes reset. Ubuntu and SSH retained."
"Reset stopped. Review again to finish the remaining owned node."
"This permanently removes VPN accounts, certificates, AdGuard settings and usage history from "
". Connected users lose access. Ubuntu, SSH and installed package binaries remain."
"Enter a person, device label, valid login and a 16+ character password."
"\n\nSave the password now; it is not returned by the user list. Share the profile and password through a trusted channel."
"New logins will be denied and current sessions for this login will be disconnected. Other devices sharing it lose access too."
" DNS requests\n\nStrong and Strict can block domains that a site needs. DNS filtering cannot reliably remove YouTube video ads."
"Compare website access afterward. You can return to Standard if a required domain is blocked."
"Add a fresh Ubuntu VPS using its SSH login. Rookstride installs the VPN and helps you manage it from your phone."
"Keep administrator access on your phone. Give others VPN profiles for the official StrongSwan app. Label separate device logins when you want individual usage and revocation."
"The VPN protects traffic to your VPS and changes the exit IP. AdGuard blocks DNS names; it cannot remove every ad. Check IP, DNS and IPv6 on each actual device."
"Removing the exit VPN and DNS data"
"The server job may still be running. Check and resume its recorded job; do not install again."
"Could not save local progress. Server jobs continue; inspect before resuming."
"Check the recorded server job before resuming"
"Android ended background polling. Detached VPS jobs continue. Reopen and resume the recorded installation."
"Phone polling ended. Detached VPS jobs may continue; reopen and check the recorded job."
" needs a reboot to load its matching kernel. Then resume this pair."
"The server job is still running. Reopen this pair to check and resume."
"Entry and exit must be distinct machines; aliases of the same VPS are refused."
"This pair uses another installer version. An explicit pair upgrade is required; resume will not replace it."
"Preparing the exit VPN and private DNS"
"Server checks passed. Test the VPN on your actual phone."
"Story text and narration are currently in English."
"Your browser suggests {language}. You can open that version or keep English."
"This page is available in English. Main pages are translated; choose a language below."
"The app is free; you choose and pay your VPS provider."
"One app for installing and managing your own gateway. No Rookstride cloud account."
"Illustrations and detailed story text stay in English in this first translation release."
"Language preference stays in this browser. No account or reading analytics."
"A VPN gateway on your own server, with a guide along the way."
"Install from your Android phone, invite people and reduce advertising noise with AdGuard Home."
"Get a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VPS with a public IPv4 address and administrator SSH access."
"Compare the SSH fingerprint with your provider’s console before trusting the server."
"See completed steps and broad time estimates. You can read the guide or stories while setup continues."
"Use Rookstride, or share a strongSwan profile. Check websites, DNS and the visible public IP on your actual device."
"A familiar language. A lower first step."
"Choose English, Russian, Persian, Arabic or Simplified Chinese. Technical values such as addresses and fingerprints keep their original characters."
"You need an Internet connection, a reachable fresh VPS and its administrator details. A VPN login is created separately."
"Android 8 or later and the signed Rookstride APK."
"Fresh Ubuntu 24.04 on one server, or two distinct servers for the two-hop recipe."
"Provider address, SSH port, administrator login and password or key. Root or passwordless sudo is required."
"The SSH fingerprint from your provider’s console, when available."
"Download the APK and verify its checksum and signing certificate. Android may ask you to allow installation from your download app."
"Choose Add gateway or Add a two-server gateway. Enter the provider’s details exactly. Keep addresses, usernames and passwords in their original form."
"Compare the presented fingerprint with your provider’s console. A changed key stops the connection. Do not approve a key you cannot identify."
"On a fresh VPS, create your first VPN login and decide whether to keep usage history. The single-server path has five checkpoints; a pair has eight."
"The installation service continues while you read Guide or Stories. Tap the progress shortcut or notification to return. Time ranges are estimates, not countdowns."
"Detached server jobs may continue. Reopen, inspect and resume the recorded job. A phone force-stop or VPS failure is not a reason to start a fresh install blindly."
"In People, choose the VPN login and Use on this phone. Enter its VPN password, approve Android’s VPN permission, then connect. The VPN password is not the root/SSH password."
"On Wi-Fi and mobile data, check websites, your exit IPv4, DNS filtering and unexpected public IPv6. The gateway provides IPv4 and intentionally blocks IPv6 Internet access."
"Create a login, export its .sswan profile and share the VPN password separately through a trusted channel. Invited users can use the official strongSwan Android app."

"Reset reviews and deletes recognized gateway data, including users, certificates, filters and history. It keeps Ubuntu, SSH and package binaries. A complete OS rebuild belongs in the provider’s panel."
"Type the exact English confirmation shown by the app, such as DELETE VPN or DELETE PAIR. Other clients lose access. Unknown installations are refused."
"VPN traffic, private DNS and administration have separate roles."
"Phone → IKEv2/IPsec → strongSwan on your VPS → IPv4 Internet. AdGuard Home filters DNS; Unbound resolves it on that VPS."
"Phone → IKEv2/IPsec entry → AmneziaWG 3.1 bridge → exit VPS → IPv4 Internet. Private DNS filtering runs at the exit. Forwarding opens after route checks."
"The app talks to each server over independently pinned SSH. The management helper is local to the VPS. There is no public Rookstride management API."
"You can see the latest observed sessions, endpoints and approximate traffic totals. Endpoints do not reliably identify physical devices, and totals are not billing records."
"A VPN does not hide GPS, account or cookie signals, guarantee website access or repair the reputation of an exit IP. DNS filtering cannot reliably remove YouTube in-video ads."
"For protection while disconnected, test Android’s Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN settings on your actual phone. These settings can affect administration of a new server."
"Two recipes are implemented. Other protocol engines remain research proposals."
"A small starting point: strongSwan, AdGuard Home and Unbound on one fresh Ubuntu VPS."
"Two distinct Ubuntu nodes, checked identities, exit-side DNS, reviewed resets, role swapping and a staged bridge. Your phone still uses the embedded strongSwan engine."
"AmneziaWG/WireGuard clients, OpenVPN and Xray/VLESS/REALITY are possible future recipes. They are not available simply because a language or route page is translated."
"Actual access depends on the client network, hosting provider and selected protocol. Test your own Wi-Fi and mobile path."
"A signed app. A matching source trail."
"Use the exact release, its checksums and corresponding source. Keep the signing certificate when updating."
"{source_mib} MiB complete source, including original artwork and exact library sources."
"The release notes identify build, emulator, voice-fixture and provider checks separately. A translated page does not turn an emulator pass into a physical-device pass."
"Narration is optional. The current story collection uses installed English offline voices in Android. If none is available, reading still works."
"Rookstride is an independent, open-source project. You can inspect, build and adapt it."
"App source, server helpers, the embedded strongSwan build, stories, notices and complete corresponding-source releases."
"Command-line strongSwan, AdGuard Home and Unbound deployment for a fresh Ubuntu server."
"The independent IKEv2 → AmneziaWG server template and its documented routing and recovery design."
"The combined app and original Rook material use GPL-3.0-or-later. Gateway scripts retain MIT. Upstream projects keep their notices and names. No vendor endorsement is implied."
"Do not put real server addresses, administrator passwords, keys, exports or private logs in public issues or source. The public website does not collect SSH credentials."
"Shared text catalogs track source changes, required placeholders and review status. Model review and screen checks are recorded separately from review by a native-speaking community contributor."
"A small red bird, a brass lantern and a habit of listening before helping."

"Lumen found Rook beside an unfinished route in an old atlas. During a storm, a little lantern oil touched the margin. Rook blinked, stepped onto the library desk and helped a stranded courier begin. Lumen offered a name, scarf and satchel; Rook chose how to use them."
"A good route leaves the next traveler a choice."
"Welcomes you and makes the next step understandable."
"Compares paths and admits when a route needs another check."
"Marks installation stages while the real progress view carries the facts."
"Shares a light, a book and room to make your own choice."
"Explains a wait without inventing a percentage or completion time."
"The stories are fiction, separate from technical or privacy guarantees. The character, poses and illustrations are original Rookstride work."
"Five connected fictional worlds, ten chapters each, two hundred illustrated pages. Read one page, a whole chapter, or listen at your own pace."
"The collection is currently written and narrated in English. Main navigation and setup are translated; story translations are a later, separate review task."
"The universal starting world: borrowed light, checked bridges, privacy and a book that leaves space for choice."
"A fictional journey inspired by selected Iranian and Persian gardens, books, crafts and shared routes."
"A fictional journey through river, craft, printing and urban garden traditions inspired by China."
"A fictional winter community, borrowed boots, a plain earflap hat and a talking loaf that learns to listen."
"A fictional American community of archives, accessible crossings, civic promises and several voices."
"These are invented local places, not portraits of every person in a country. The cultural notes and primary sources remain available in English."
"A useful first app. A careful next chapter."
"Android works today. Browser, iPhone and messenger tools need their own implementation and checks. These plans are not download promises."
"English, Russian, Persian, Arabic and Simplified Chinese cover the first practical flows. Flexible layout, right-to-left support and shared catalogs make later updates reviewable."
"First, help choose a recipe and open the native installer without putting passwords in the plan. Ordinary browsers and PWAs cannot open raw SSH connections."

"A later local companion or self-hosted connector could provide browser management. It needs authenticated HTTPS, SSH identity checks, bounded actions, durable jobs and a private credential boundary."
"Research native SSH, Keychain storage, Apple VPN permissions and review requirements. Reuse recipe contracts; the Android VPN engine is not automatically an iPhone engine."
"A future bot or Mini App could guide onboarding and report approved status. Validate sessions and require explicit approval for changes. Root passwords and private keys must not be sent in chats."
"Evaluate the actual platform APIs, domain rules, account eligibility and review requirements before promising support. A status assistant is a separate gate from a VPN client or SSH installer."
"Verify server identity before credentials, keep protocol choices explicit, preserve reset review and fail-closed routing, and test interruption, recovery and real devices."
"Read the detailed English research and backlog"
"Choose the language for the next steps. You can change it later."
"Stories are in English for now; setup and everyday controls use your chosen language."
"Planning range: about {range} min for remaining stages"
"Enter the exact English confirmation. Technical values and passwords are not translated."
"The app follows a supported phone language by default, with English fallback."
"Installation stopped. Open the installation guide before retrying."
